name: BOOMERANG
impact: Confused deputy attack breaks ARM TrustZone TEEs (QSEE, Huawei, OP-TEE) via the semantic gap between secure and non-secure worlds
boundary_statement: BOOMERANG (NDSS 2017) is a confused deputy attack on ARM TrustZone TEEs (Qualcomm QSEE, Huawei, OP-TEE) exploiting the semantic gap between secure and non-secure worlds. It does not affect Intel TDX or AMD SEV-SNP. CVEs: CVE-2016-5349, CVE-2016-8762/3/4.

INTENT.evidence: GitHub README: BOOMERANG exploits the 'semantic gap between the non-secure and secure worlds'; PoC exploits on Qualcomm (QSEE) and Huawei chipsets; CVEs CVE-2016-5349, CVE-2016-8762/3/4. ARM TrustZone attack, no TDX/SEV-SNP mention.
